scenarios.situationText: Riverton flood-displacement affects 180 households. Accommodation reaches capacity at 18:00. Request temporary accommodation and transport.
Riverton has repeated reports of unmet accommodation and transport needs.
Meadowfield information only: confirm available temporary support before a request.
Flood water is stable. Temporary accommodation has spare capacity and scheduled transport remains available. Review support coordination during normal operating hours.
An unspecified area may need temporary support. Confirm the area and the incident.
